details.groundedness_reasoning: The target asserts that no IOI contestant has exactly 5 golds and 1 bronze. Such a record would require at least six participations. Citation [1] lists the contestants with six or more participations and their gold, silver, and bronze counts; none of those listed has 5 golds and 1 bronze. The remaining listed contestants have at most five participations, so they could not have earned six medals. The citation therefore supports the target’s negative claim.
